data.gender_notes: Aafia is used as a unisex name in islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Health; well-being; soundness; freedom from illness
data.long_meaning: From Arabic ʿāfiya (عافية) 'health, well-being, soundness', from the root ʿ-f-w which also gives ʿafw 'pardon' and ʿāfī 'in good health'. Aafia therefore means “Health; well-being; soundness; freedom from illness”. Arabic noun ʿāfiya 'health, well-being'; a common Muslim female given name.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aafia expresses “Honorable”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From Arabic ʿāfiya (عافية) 'health, well-being, soundness', from the root ʿ-f-w which also gives ʿafw 'pardon' and ʿāfī 'in good health'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aafia total 18, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

faq.q: What does Aafia mean in Arabic?
faq.a: Aafia is the Arabic noun ʿāfiya (عافية), meaning 'health, well-being, soundness' - freedom from illness and harm. It comes from the root ʿ-f-w.

faq.q: What does the name Aafia mean?
faq.a: Aafia means “Health; well-being; soundness; freedom from illness”.

faq.q: Where does the name Aafia come from?
What is the linguistic root of Aafia?
faq.a: The root of Aafia is ع-ف-و (ʿ-f-w).

faq.q: How is Aafia written in Arabic script?
faq.a: Aafia is written عافية in Arabic script.

faq.q: Is Aafia a boy's or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aafia is used as a female name.

faq.q: Does Aafia appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aafia is not a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aafia verified?
faq.a: Yes — the meaning “Health; well-being; soundness; freedom from illness” is established by Arabic noun ʿāfiya 'health, well-being'; a common Muslim female given name..
